# Plugin.Maui.SecureStoragePlus

Better secure storage for .NET MAUI on iOS and Android, with AES-256-GCM encryption, value expiry, and migration from MAUI SecureStorage.

Repository: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/SecureStoragePlus
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.SecureStoragePlus
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-secure-storage-plus
Catalog: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

Platforms: Android, iOS. Mac Catalyst and Windows are not primary targets.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.SecureStoragePlus

Registration: `UseSecureStoragePlus` — see README.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I expire a token in MAUI SecureStorage?
- AES-256-GCM secure storage for MAUI
- Migrate off MAUI SecureStorage with listing and metadata

## Do not use when

- MAUI SecureStorage already meets the need (no expiry / listing required)
- You need encrypted files rather than small secrets — use Plugin.Maui.FileVault
